architecture.description:
### High Level Architecture

#### Application type
Serverless banking API application deployed on AWS cloud infrastructure

#### Layers
- API Gateway: HTTP API for external client access
- Compute: AWS Lambda serverless functions (Python 3.11)
- Data: Amazon RDS PostgreSQL database
- Authentication: Amazon Cognito User Pool
- Logging: CloudWatch Logs

#### Boundaries
- Internet to API Gateway (public access)
- API Gateway to Lambda (AWS internal)
- Lambda to RDS within VPC (10.20.0.0/16)
- Admin operations boundary for account management

#### Technology components
- AWS API Gateway HTTP API
- AWS Lambda (Python 3.11 runtime)
- Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4
- Amazon Cognito User Pool
- AWS KMS for encryption
- CloudWatch Logs
- Terraform IaC

#### Deployment architecture
- Single AWS region (us-east-1)
- VPC with two public subnets across AZs
- Lambda in VPC with security groups
- RDS in DB subnet group
- Publicly accessible database

#### APIs
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| /accounts/{accountId} | GET | Retrieve account information |
| /accounts/{accountId}/transactions | GET | Get transaction history |
| /admin/freeze-account | POST | Admin account freeze operation |

#### Security relevant components
- Cognito authentication with password policies
- IAM roles with overly broad permissions (logs:*, rds:*, kms:*, cognito-idp:*)
- KMS key available but RDS storage unencrypted
- Database credentials in Terraform variables
- Public database accessibility

### Low Level Architecture
- AWS VPC (10.20.0.0/16) with public subnets in two AZs
- API Gateway HTTP API with Lambda proxy integration
- Lambda function with VPC configuration and security group
- RDS PostgreSQL instance in public subnets with security group
- Cognito User Pool with client configuration
- CloudWatch Log Group for Lambda logging
- IAM execution role with attached policy
- KMS key with alias for encryption capabilities
- Security groups for Lambda (all outbound) and RDS (port 5432 from VPC)
- DB subnet group spanning both availability zones
